meta.title: Kokand Dry Fruits — Premium Dried Fruits & Nuts from Uzbekistan
meta.description: Premium quality dried fruits, nuts, and natural products sourced from the heart of Kokand, Uzbekistan. Exported to 20+ countries worldwide.

hero.title: Premium Dried Fruits & Nuts
hero.subtitle: Naturally sourced, carefully selected, and delivered worldwide — bringing the authentic taste of Uzbekistan's finest harvest to your table.

slides.title: Delivered To Your Home Country
slides.subtitle: Shipping to 20+ countries with careful, food-safe packaging — from our warehouse in Kokand straight to your door.

slides.title: Honest Prices, Direct From The Source
slides.subtitle: We buy straight from Fergana Valley farms, so you get premium quality without the middleman markup.

slides.title: Nuts Picked At Their Peak
slides.subtitle: Almonds, walnuts and pistachios selected by hand, stored properly, and never treated with preservatives.

strengths.sectionSubtitle: We combine centuries-old traditions with modern quality standards

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.description: Every product undergoes rigorous quality testing. Only the finest, preservative-free dried fruits and nuts make it to our shelves.

fresh.title: Always Fresh
fresh.description: Our products are continuously restocked and stored under optimal conditions to preserve their natural taste and nutritional value.

delivery.title: Global Delivery
delivery.description: Fast, reliable shipping to over 20 countries. Your products arrive safely packaged and on time, every time.

selection.title: Wide Selection
selection.description: From golden raisins to premium pistachios — over 100 varieties of dried fruits, nuts, and natural snacks in one place.

products.sectionSubtitle: Explore our diverse selection of premium dried fruits and nuts

prunes.name: Dried Plums (Prunes)
prunes.description: Sweet and full-flavoured, served with tea and used throughout cooking and confectionery. They keep for a long time, so they are easy to stock.

peanuts.name: Peanuts
peanuts.description: Rich in protein, healthy fatty acids, potassium, magnesium and B vitamins. They give the body energy and strengthen the immune system.

walnuts.name: Dried Walnuts
walnuts.description: Walnuts carry protein, nourishing fatty acids, potassium, magnesium, iron and vitamin E. They support memory and help build immunity.

driedApricots.name: Pitted Dried Apricots
driedApricots.description: High in vitamin A, vitamin C, iron and potassium, which support the heart and blood vessels. They also aid digestion.

raisins.name: Raisins
raisins.description: Grapes dried the natural way. Prized for their sweetness, their goodness and how well they keep.

mungBeans.name: Mung Beans
mungBeans.description: Rich in protein, fibre, iron, magnesium and B vitamins. They aid digestion, give energy and suit light, dietary cooking.
